title: High-thermal-conductivity heat-spreading materials
body:
We grow and engineer wide-bandgap heat-spreading materials — diamond, 3C-SiC, and AlN — and tailor their thermal properties for integration with real devices.

Combining epitaxial growth, precision thermal metrology (TDTR / FDTR / Raman mapping), and theory, we turn grain size, doping, and interface structure into designable knobs for heat dissipation.
bodyZh:
我们生长并调控金刚石、3C-SiC、AlN 等宽禁带高导热材料，针对真实器件集成需求定制其热学性能。

通过将外延生长、精密热测试（TDTR / FDTR / Raman mapping）与理论相结合，我们把晶粒尺寸、掺杂和界面结构转化为可设计的散热调控参量。

points.en: Wafer-scale single-crystal 3C-SiC with record in-plane and cross-plane thermal conductivity (Nat. Commun. 2022)
points.zh: 晶圆级单晶 3C-SiC，面内与面外热导率均创纪录（Nat. Commun. 2022）

points.en: SiC polytype boundaries with thermal boundary conductance above 2000 MW/m²·K — the highest reported to date
points.zh: SiC 多型体边界热导突破 2000 MW/m²·K，为迄今已知最高纪录

points.en: Low-temperature (<450 °C) BEOL-compatible diamond integrated on GaN transistors, cutting device temperature by 111 °C at 24 W/mm
points.zh: 低温（<450 °C）后道兼容金刚石集成于 GaN 晶体管，24 W/mm 功耗下器件温度下降 111 °C

points.en: B- and N-doped 3C-SiC with the largest thermal-conductivity tunability among common semiconductors
points.zh: B、N 掺杂 3C-SiC 实现常见半导体中最大的热导率可调范围

points.en: AlN films with intrinsic room-temperature thermal conductivity up to 321 W/m·K
points.zh: 本征 AlN 薄膜室温最高热导率达 321 W/m·K
